preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xi <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= yi <= 10**9 for xi, yi in points)
preconditions.description: Each point's coordinates xi and yi are between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of points in the input list matches the given n.
All points in the input list are distinct.

postconditions.description: The size of the good superset m is between n and 200,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xi <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= yi <= 10**9 for xi, yi in superset)
postconditions.description: Each point's coordinates xi and yi in the superset are between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of points in the superset matches the given m.

postconditions.expression: all(any((x1 == x2 or y1 == y2 or any((x1 <= x <= x2 and y1 <= y <= y2) for x, y in superset if (x, y) != (x1, y1) and (x, y) != (x2, y2))) for x2, y2 in superset) for x1, y1 in superset)
postconditions.description: For any two points in the superset, at least one of the three conditions is true: they lie on the same horizontal line, they lie on the same vertical line, or the rectangle with corners at these two points contains at least one other point from the superset.
